title: Application-to-product finder — original demo plan
problem: SYNTHETIC: a compatible product is missed by an application query while its exact SKU is found.
improvement: Map application attributes to a small, explicit catalog and explain each recommendation.
demo_plan: Build an original local comparison using 12 fictional SKUs and six prewritten buyer queries; record baseline and proposed result relevance.
simulated: All catalog entries, stock, customer behavior and pricing are fictional. Search-quality uplift and commercial value are unmeasured.
benefit_hypothesis: More buyers may reach a compatible product without knowing its SKU; no revenue uplift is established.
measurement: Compare top-three relevant results and completion time on six held-out tasks. Ask a domain expert to validate compatibility before a real pilot.
pricing_assumptions: No quoted price. Time-box a prototype to two hours; scope, costs and commercial pricing require a separate agreement.
question: How do buyers describe the application when they do not know a part number?
